visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) An Asian woman with black hair and glasses, wearing a light-patterned cardigan, holds a large dark green rectangular gift box towards the camera in a bright kitchen environment. (2) She opens the lid of the box, revealing three distinct glass bottles of Seedlip non-alcoholic spirits cushioned in white packaging. (3) A sequence of close-up product shots follows: first, a clear bottle labeled 'Grove 42' with a colorful squirrel illustration; second, 'Garden 108' featuring a green plant-like creature; third, 'Spice 94' with a multi-colored abstract botanical graphic. (4) The woman is then seen in the kitchen using a wooden tool to juice half an orange over two small tumblers already garnished with orange slices. A 'MATURE' brand bottle stands on the counter. (5) She pours a clear liquid from the Seedlip bottle into the glasses, mixing it with the fresh orange juice and sparkling water. (6) Finally, she lifts both glasses towards the camera, smiling, and clinks them against a glass held by an off-screen person.
